What a thrilling and personal question! If I could change the world in one way, I would make it a more equitable and sustainable place by ensuring that every individual has access to clean air, water, and land, while also having the opportunity to thrive in a diverse and healthy ecosystem.

Specifically, I would work to eradicate pollution in all its forms, reversing the damage that's been done to our planet's natural systems. This would involve a global effort to transition to renewable energy sources, implement circular economies that minimize waste, and protect and restore natural habitats like forests, wetlands, and oceans.

By doing so, I believe we could not only mitigate the impacts of climate change but also create a world where every person can live a healthy, fulfilling life, surrounded by the beauty and wonder of nature. It's a tall order, I know, but what a wonderful world it would be!
